I booked Honeybook Studio for my pre-wedding shoot after seeing their polished Instagram and Google reviews. I paid Rs. 20,000 for a full-day shoot (originally a Rs. 25,000 plan), and also spent Rs. 1,200 for lunch. I was genuinely excited and had high expectations – but everything went downhill the moment we arrived.

The studio was in terrible condition. Walls were peeling, paint was faded, and the sets looked completely artificial and neglected. Many props were broken, lights didn’t work, and it felt like the place had been left untouched since its launch. Our mood was ruined from the start, especially after traveling 4–5 hours just to reach there.

The staff behavior was unprofessional. We had pre-booked breakfast, but by the time we arrived, most items were cold or finished. On top of all this, the studio is located in a remote village area with very poor mobile network – which made things worse when we needed to coordinate.

My honest advice: don’t fall for their staged photos or promo videos. Unless they renovate and maintain their sets, this place is just not worth the money or effort. You’d be better off choosing a well-maintained public spot for a free or budget-friendly shoot.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshi Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I don’t usually write long reviews, but this team deserves every word. I have never experienced this level of ease and peace of mind with any team that feels like family, before. Dhruv and Sourabh led an absolutely amazing team-experienced, prepared, and so deeply tuned in to every moment that mattered.

They didn’t just take photos; they made sure we lived our moments too. They would literally push my parents to step out of their Marwadi hospitality mode and actually enjoy their own celebration. They guided my CA couple to pose (which is honestly a task in itself!), and they did it with so much patience, warmth, and humour.

What touched me the most was how invested they were. I would have to force them to go eat because they were so focused on capturing everything perfectly. From late nights to early mornings, they showed up with the same energy, the same dedication, and the same big-hearted enthusiasm.

Their work ethic, their vibe, their passion — everything is admirable. My entire family is genuinely grateful that they were part of our celebration. They didn’t just capture our memories… they became a beautiful part of them.

Highly, highly recommended.
